events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 1222 PM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 13 miles east of Colquitt to 8 miles southeast
of Bainbridge. Movement was northeast at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Newton, Bainbridge, Cairo, Pelham, Camilla, Whigham, West Bainbridge,
Climax, Ausmac, Flint, Capel, Harrells Still, Peoples Still,
Mimsville, Branchville, Nickleville, Bellview, Vada, Akridge, and
Elpino.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northwestern Gadsden County in Big Bend Florida...
Southern Decatur County in southwestern Georgia...

* WHEN...Until 315 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1218 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Bainbridge, West Bainbridge, Greensboro, Gretna, Attapulgus,
Climax, Faceville, Fowlstown, Recovery, Mount Pleasant, Laingkat,
Dogtown, Hanover, Douglas City, Hardaway, Amsterdam, Rosedale and
Sycamore.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

A Marine Weather Statement has been issued for the following areas...
Waters from Altamaha Sound GA to Fernandina Beach FL from 20 to 60
NM...
Waters from Fernandina Beach to St. Augustine FL from 20 to 60
NM...

Augustine, moving northeast at 15 knots.
